reason: Review found that pre-draw scene creation could draw newly constructed cameras while their matrices were still identity. The UIMSD first-ready timestamp could therefore precede a correctly projected frame. Refresh transforms before drawing, including cameras created by draw-time UIMSD layout, without calling simulation update, advancing pans/shakes, or consuming RNG. Preserve raw native/display outcomes and do not accept a model-ready or misprojected frame as a performance result.
